name: 百度网盘
description: Downloads files shared on Baidu Netdisk (pan.baidu.com/s/...?pwd=...), single files or whole folders; asks for the extraction code when the link has none. Needs your login cookies: each file is saved to /zoo-downloader in your netdisk before it downloads, and files saved there more than 8 hours ago are deleted on later downloads.

credentialsHelp.zh-TW:
1. 在瀏覽器登入 pan.baidu.com
2. 按 F12 開啟開發人員工具 →「應用程式」(Application) →「Cookie」→ https://pan.baidu.com
3. 找到下面兩個名稱，把「值」(Value) 整段複製貼上

登出百度後會失效，到時再複製一次。
credentialsHelp.en:
1. Sign in at pan.baidu.com in your browser
2. Press F12 → Application → Cookies → https://pan.baidu.com
3. Find the two names below and copy their whole Value

Signing out of Baidu makes them stop working; copy them again then.
credentialsHelp.ja:
1. ブラウザーで pan.baidu.com にログイン
2. F12 →「アプリケーション」(Application) →「Cookie」→ https://pan.baidu.com
3. 下の 2 つの名前を探し、「値」(Value) をすべてコピーして貼り付け

Baidu からログアウトすると無効になるので、そのときはもう一度コピーしてください。

help.zh-TW: 名稱為 BDUSS 的 cookie 的值
help.en: The Value of the cookie named BDUSS
help.ja: 名前が BDUSS の Cookie の値
